physical_obstruction_and_39_scope.supported: Positive-capacity directed path analysis finds specific unreachable destination contracts, including Storage53→99 for early jobs. Saved receiving rows were full and form a dependency DAG into53. This does not prove a circular-wait deadlock or a universally impossible airport.
physical_obstruction_and_39_scope.39_assumptions: Sum of reachable FIFO prefixes while never loading an unreachable head, fixed original input/no ties and no off-carrier release. The actual incumbent additionally uses one circulating tray and21 parked trays. Do not call39 an unconditional global upper bound.
physical_obstruction_and_39_scope.371_relaxation: The21-bad-load resource relaxation gives371 only as a relaxed upper bound, not an achievable schedule or permission to sacrifice jobs.
physical_obstruction_and_39_scope.important_exception: Native max_decisions_exceeded can fail_bag and erase a queue head. Therefore do not write unconditional permanent blocking. Any study of naturally triggered failures must retain identical baseline rules, all28506 jobs, failed counts and residual loaded-tray resources; proactively failing bad heads is not normal-service improvement.
physical_obstruction_and_39_scope.next_method_gap: A multi-active-tray/rolling cooperation method needs fresh local possession, actual receiving capacity, delivered obligation evidence, per-job protection and a failure-aware FIFO argument. Local reachability is necessary but not sufficient for a realizable protected schedule.
